Childs.Definition: Indicates with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to identify the type of replacement part/accessory.

Childs.Title: UNCLASSIFIED
Childs.Definition: This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified.

Childs.Title: UNIDENTIFIED
Childs.Definition: This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information.

Childs.Title: Cargo Management Other (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a cargo management product, where the user of the schema is not able to classify the products in existing bricks within the schema.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes all currently classified cargo management products.

Childs.Title: Cargo Management Ramps/Ramp Accessories (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a ramp or sloping platform that aids the loading/offloading of cargo and people from a vehicle. Such ramps may come equipped with rails to ensure the direction of cargo loading/offloading and are particularly useful in aiding the entry and exit of wheelchairs.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes products such as vehicle servicing ramps or lifts.

Childs.Title: Cargo Securing Equipment (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a device designed to fasten and secure automotive cargo. Includes hooks, buckles, straps, ropes, shock cords and web slings, all designed to keep cargo secure and help lift or move the cargo.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes any other car accessories and hardware not specifically designed to secure cargo.

Childs.Title: Type of Securing Equipment
Childs.Definition: Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the type of securing product described.

Childs.Title: Equipment Racks/Carriers (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a frame, attached to the roof, boot or back door of an automotive vehicle and specifically designed to transport cargo, such as tyres, bikes, canoes, ladders, skis or surfboards. Includes racks specifically designed to transport guns safely, such as under seat, back seat, over-head, floor mount car gun racks.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes all racks that are not specifically designed for automotive vehicles.

Childs.Title: Type of Equipment Rack/Carrier
Childs.Definition: Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the purpose of the equipment rack.

Childs.Title: UNCLASSIFIED
Childs.Definition: This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified.

Childs.Title: UNIDENTIFIED
Childs.Definition: This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information.

Childs.Title: Extenders/Bumper Packs (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a device, specifically designed to increase boot capacity, to expand the volume of the truck bed for more loading capacity and folds away. The products include devices that keep open boots secure over bulky items and those designed to be mounted on the bumper of an automotive vehicle to transport heavy objects.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes all other cargo extenders not specifically designed for automotive vehicles.

Childs.Title: Type of Extender/Bumper Pack
Childs.Definition: Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the type of automotive extra cargo holder.

Childs.Title: REAR MOUNT/LUGGAGE EXTENDER
Childs.Definition: Luggage box that has to be placed on the back of an automotive, fixed on a hook.

Childs.Title: ROOF/LUGGAGE BOX
Childs.Definition: Luggage box that has to be placed on the roof of an automotive, fixed on bars.

Childs.Title: UNCLASSIFIED
Childs.Definition: This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified.

Childs.Title: UNIDENTIFIED
Childs.Definition: This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information.

Childs.Title: Exterior Storage Carriers/Bags (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a flexible container, attached to the car roof via a luggage rack, sports bar or car clips on vehicles without a luggage rack.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes roof racks and straps.

Childs.Title: Interior Storage Boxes/Trays/Baskets (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a container, constructed with four sides perpendicular to the base and often having a lid or covers, specifically designed to store objects in the car. Includes car tool boxes and boot organisers.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes all other containers not specifically designed for automotive vehicles.

Childs.Title: Type of Interior Storage
Childs.Definition: Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the type of interior storage.

Childs.Title: UNCLASSIFIED
Childs.Definition: This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified.

Childs.Title: UNIDENTIFIED
Childs.Definition: This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information.

Childs.Title: Wheel Chocks (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as triangular blocks that are placed under the wheels of a car or truck to prevent the vehicle moving when loading/unloading heavy cargo. These products normally have anti-slip traction pads underneath the blocks and may be designed with optional mounting brackets.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes products such as wheel chocks for aviation use and other classified wheel hardware.

Childs.Title: Accent Lighting (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a loose functional or decorative neon light kit, often complete with a built-in transformer and a wire hook-up, specifically designed to accentuate interior or exterior parts of the car, such as, for example, licence plates.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes any other accent lights not specifically designed for cars as well as under car lighting.

Childs.Title: Decorative Lighting Other (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a light, specifically designed to enhance a car appearance, where the user of the schema is not able to classify the products in existing bricks within the schema.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes all currently classified Decorative Lighting products.

Childs.Title: Decorative Lighting Variety Packs (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products than can be described/observed as two or more automotive decorative lighting products, sold together, which exist within the schema belonging to different bricks but to the same class, that is two or more products contained within the same pack which cross bricks within the automotive decorative lighting class. Items that are received free with purchases should be removed from the classification decision-making process.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes Accent lighting and products classified within different classes sold together.

Childs.Title: Strobe Lighting (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as an automotive flash lamp that produces high-intensity short-duration light pulses by electric discharge in a gas.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes any other strobe lights not specifically designed for cars.

Childs.Title: Under-Car Lighting
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as an under car light kit, often complete with an in-car mounted digital control.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes any other decorative lights not specifically designed to be installed under the car.

Childs.Title: Automotive Electrical - Replacement Parts/Accessories
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as replacement parts or accessories for Automotive Electrical products. Includes products such as Fuse Blocks and Fuse Holders.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes Automotive Switches and all products currently catered for in the Automotive Electrical class.

Childs.Title: Type of Replacement Part/Accessory
Childs.Definition: Indicates with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to identify the type of replacement part/accessory.

Childs.Title: UNCLASSIFIED
Childs.Definition: This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified.

Childs.Title: UNIDENTIFIED
Childs.Definition: This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information.

Childs.Title: Automotive Instruments and Measurement Systems
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as automotive instrument systems or measurement systems.

Childs.Title: Type of Automotive Instruments/Measurement Systems
Childs.Definition: Indicates with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the manufacturer to identify the type of automotive instruments/measurement system.

Childs.Title: UNCLASSIFIED
Childs.Definition: This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified.

Childs.Title: UNIDENTIFIED
Childs.Definition: This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information.

Childs.Title: Automotive Switches
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as an automotive device used to break or open an electric circuit or to divert current from one conductor to another. Includes products such as disconnectors and relays of various types designed for all types of cars.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes fuses and accessories and switches not specifically designed for cars.

Childs.Title: Type of Automotive Switch
Childs.Definition: Indicate, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the type of electrical switch directly related to an automobile.

Childs.Title: UNCLASSIFIED
Childs.Definition: This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified.

Childs.Title: UNIDENTIFIED
Childs.Definition: This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information.

Childs.Title: Cigarette Lighters/Adaptors (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as an electrical device for lighting a cigarette. The products also include a unit for connecting other devices to the car cigarette lighter.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes products not specifically designed to use in a car.

Childs.Title: Built-in/Extension Cable
Childs.Definition: Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify whether the product is built-in or attached with an extension cable.

Childs.Title: UNIDENTIFIED
Childs.Definition: This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information.

Childs.Title: Electrical Other (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as an electrical device, specifically designed for use in the car, where the user of the schema is not able to classify the products in existing bricks within the schema.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes all currently classified electrical automotive devices.

Childs.Title: Electrical Variety Packs (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products than can be described/observed as two or more electrical devices, specifically designed for use in the car, sold together, which exist within the schema belonging to different bricks but to the same class, that is two or more products contained within the same pack which cross bricks within the Electrical class. Items that are received free with purchases should be removed from the classification decision-making process.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes fuse kits and products classified within different classes sold together, such as electrical devices and lamps or bulbs sold together.

Childs.Title: Flex Tube/Wire Loom (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as tubing or loom designed to be installed in a car to organise multiple tangled wires and cables into one neat cable bundle.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes any wire looms or tubes not specifically designed to be used in a car.

Childs.Title: Fuses (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as an electrical device that can interrupt the flow of an electrical current when it is overloaded.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes any fuses not specifically designed for use in a car.

Childs.Title: Horns/Sirens (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a car device for making a loud sound as a warning or signal.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes any siren not specifically designed to be used in a car.

Childs.Title: Sockets/Pigtails (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a device in a wall designed to be put into a car cigarette lighter in order to connect electrical equipment to the power supply.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes any other products not specifically designed for use in a car.

Childs.Title: Coverings/Protection Other (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a covering, specifically designed to protect car parts, where the user of the schema is not able to classify the products in existing bricks within the schema.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes all currently classified car protective products.

Childs.Title: Door Guards (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a covering that is permanently attached to and specifically designed to protect car doors from scratches and damage.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes all other door covers not specifically designed for automotive vehicles or covers that are not attached to the car.

Childs.Title: Lens Covers (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a covering, specifically designed to protect car light lenses from scratches and rocks.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes all other car covers and light covers not specifically designed for automotive vehicles.

Childs.Title: License Plate Frame/Shields
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a metal, rubber or plastic frame, specifically designed to protect a car licence plate and enhance its appearance
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes car plate accent lighting and car covers not specifically designed for licence plates.

Childs.Title: License Plates - Decorative
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a novelty frame, sign or accessory, specifically designed to enhance appearance of the licence plate.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes car plate accent lighting.

Childs.Title: Paint Protection Films (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a film, specifically designed to enhance appearance of the car and provide protection to the paint.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes any other protection film not specifically designed for car paint.

Childs.Title: Spare Tyre Covers
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a flexible container that can also be attached to the car back door, specifically designed for transporting a spare car tyre.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes tyre carriers and racks.

Childs.Title: Splash Guards/Mud Flaps
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a flexible panel, specifically designed to guard the body of the car from mud, snow, slush and road debris contained within the vehicles wheel.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes car spoilers and covers.

Childs.Title: Tops/Skins - Replacement Parts/Accessories (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as an accessory to a flexible top that is specifically designed to replace a worn car top.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes car covers.

Childs.Title: Truck Hardware/Kits
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a fastener or bolt that can be sold as kits.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes any other products not specifically designed for trucks.

Childs.Title: Vehicle Covers
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a cover, specifically designed to protect car parts, such as bumpers or mirrors from scratches and damage. These can include complete car covers and part specific covers.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes all other covers not specifically designed for automotive vehicles.

Childs.Title: Type of Vehicle Coverage
Childs.Definition: Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify whether the cover partially covers the vehicle or not.

Childs.Title: UNCLASSIFIED
Childs.Definition: This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified.

Childs.Title: UNIDENTIFIED
Childs.Definition: This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information.

Childs.Title: Brush/Grill Guards
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a bar or a frame, specifically designed to protect the car front end.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes bumpers.

Childs.Title: Bumpers
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a metal or rubber bar attached to either end of a motor vehicle, such as a truck or car, to absorb impact in a collision.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes grills and covers.

Childs.Title: Decorative/Custom Grills
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a bar or a frame, specifically designed to enhance appearance of the front end.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes bumper and grill guards.

Childs.Title: Grill Inserts
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a custom made insert, specifically designed to enhance the appearance of the front end of the car. The products include cut-out and bolt over inserts
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes grills and bars.

Childs.Title: Push/A Bars (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a steel bar or a frame, specifically designed to give a car an "off road" look and added strength.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes grill bars and bumpers.

Childs.Title: Skid Plates
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a metal plate, specifically designed to protect the engine, sump or exhaust headers from damage caused when driving.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes car body covers.

Childs.Title: Extruded/Cast Steps (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a metal or plastic plate attached to either side of a motor vehicle, such as a truck or car, to serve as an aid to get in and out of the car. Products also include those designed to lower and retract automatically when the doors are opened or closed.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes nerf bars and running boards.

Childs.Title: Nerf/Step Bars (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a metal bar attached to either side of a motor vehicle, such as a truck or car, to protect the paint and to enhance appearance. These products also have a secondary function in that they serve as an aid to get in and out of the car.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes extruded and cast iron steps and running boards.

Childs.Title: Running Boards (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a metal or plastic board attached to either side of a motor vehicle, such as a truck or car. The products serve as an aid to get in and out of the car.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes extruded and cast iron steps and nerf steps.

Childs.Title: Bug/Hood Shields (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a metal or fibreglass plate, specifically designed to change the shape of the front of the vehicle, thereby altering the flow of air up and over the windshield as the vehicle moves.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes car body covers, visors and fairings.

Childs.Title: Cab Fairings
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a fibreglass plate, specifically designed to extend the lines of the cab and to act as a sunshade, shading the rear window and cargo area.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes car visors.

Childs.Title: Front Windshield Visors
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a panel, attached to the windshield, specifically designed to reduce sunglare at daytime or headlight glare of oncoming traffic and reduce eye strain at night.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes car top, rear and side window deflectors.

Childs.Title: Rear Window Deflector/Roof Visors (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a panel, attached to the roof or rear window, specifically designed to reduce sunglare at daytime.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes car windshield and side window deflectors.

Childs.Title: Side Window Deflector/Visors
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a panel, attached to the side window, specifically designed to reduce sunglare.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes car top, rear and windshield deflectors.

Childs.Title: Sunroof Deflectors
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a panel, mounted to the vehicle's roof, specifically designed to reduce sunglare and wind noise when open air driving.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes car windshield deflectors.

Childs.Title: Custom Hoods
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a custom-fit hardware designed to replace a car's hood that is specifically designed to enhance a car's performance and appearance and is specifically coated to prevent rust and is normally reinforced for maximum strength.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes car body covers.

Childs.Title: Emblems/Graphics - Decorative (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a distinctive badge, design or device, designed to mark an automotive vehicle with the company emblem or just to enhance its appearance.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes emblems not specifically designed for cars. Also excludes pin-striping.

Childs.Title: Exterior Appearance Accessories Other (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a covering, specifically designed to enhance the exterior appearance of the car, where the user of the schema is not able to classify the products in existing bricks within the schema.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes all currently classified car exterior appearance products.

Childs.Title: Exterior Appearance Accessories Variety Packs
Childs.Definition: Includes any products than can be described/observed as two or more distinct products, specifically designed to enhance an exterior appearance of the car, sold together, which exist within the schema belonging to different bricks but to the same class, that is two or more products contained within the same pack which cross bricks within the Exterior Appearance products class. Items that are received free with purchases should be removed from the classification decision-making process.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes products classified within different classes sold together sold together.

Childs.Title: Fenders/Fender Flares
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a custom-fit hardware designed to accentuate the wheel, to add a tyre coverage and to stop tyre-flung rocks and debris. Includes products such as fenders, fender trims and fender flares.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes car body covers.

Childs.Title: Light/Lens Mouldings (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a custom-fit hardware designed to accentuate the car lights and lenses and to add coverage and protection.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes side window mouldings and coverings.

Childs.Title: Louvres (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a slatted panel, designed for ventilation, e.g. on the hood of a motor vehicle. The products include louvres that are specifically designed for car windows to reduce the sun glare.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes car covers and visors.

Childs.Title: Scoops/Vents (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as car hardware, designed for ventilation of the engine.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes car covers, louvers and visors.

Childs.Title: Side Window Mouldings/Covers (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a custom-fit hardware designed to accentuate the side windows and to reduce sunglare.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes light/lense mouldings and side window visors.

Childs.Title: Sunroofs/Moonroofs/T-tops (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a sliding panel, designed to be installed in a car roof and increase ventilation.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes visors.

Childs.Title: Wings/Spoilers (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as car hardware, designed as an air deflector mounted usually at the rear of a car to reduce lift at high speeds.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes car covers and mouldings.

Childs.Title: Air/Dust Filter Cleaner
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a preparation specifically designed to clean the air/dust filter. Specifically includes chemicals that are designed to clean air/dust filters.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes any other chemical designed to improve car performance.

Childs.Title: Exhaust Filter Cleaner
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a preparation specifically designed to clean the exhaust filter or catalytic converter. Specifically includes chemicals that are designed to clean exhaust filters for example by addition in the fuel tank.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes any other chemical designed to improve car performance.

Childs.Title: Filter Accessories (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a device, used in conjunction with any type of automotive filter to enhance its performance.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes complete automotive filters.

Childs.Title: Filters - Air (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a device, containing a material, to extract impurities from air.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes any other type of automotive filters, such as fluid filters.

Childs.Title: Type of Air Filter
Childs.Definition: Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the specific area in which the air filter is designed to operate.

Childs.Title: UNCLASSIFIED
Childs.Definition: This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified.

Childs.Title: UNIDENTIFIED
Childs.Definition: This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information.

Childs.Title: Filters - Fluid (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a device, containing such a material, used to extract impurities from automotive fluids. These will include water filters used within automobiles.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes any other type of automotive filter, such as air filters.

Childs.Title: Type of Fluid Filter
Childs.Definition: Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the specific area in which the fluid filter is designed to operate.

Childs.Title: UNCLASSIFIED
Childs.Definition: This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market; e.g. goat's cheese - goat's cheeses is often generically labelled and cannot be further classified.

Childs.Title: UNIDENTIFIED
Childs.Definition: This term is used to describe those product attributes that are unidentifiable given existing or available product information.

Childs.Title: Filters Other (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a product, specifically designed to be used in a car part to remove impurities from air and fluid, where the user of the schema is not able to classify the products in existing bricks within the schema.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes all currently classified car filter products.

Childs.Title: Filters Variety Packs (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products than can be described/observed as two or more distinct products, specifically designed to be used as or in conjunction with any type of an automotive filter, sold together, which exist within the schema belonging to different bricks but to the same class, that is two or more products contained within the same pack which cross bricks within the Automotive Filters class. Items that are received free with purchases should be removed from the classification decision-making process.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes products classified within different classes sold together.

Childs.Title: Performance Filter Kits/Accessories (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a set of devices used as or in conjunction with a filter. A kit may contain a filter and various accessories.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes filter and accessories not sold as a kit.

Childs.Title: Transmission Filters (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a device, containing a material, which extracts impurities from transmission fluid.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes any other type of automotive filter.

Childs.Title: Fluid Change Items Other (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a product, specifically designed to be used to aid automotive fluid change, where the user of the schema is not able to classify the products in existing bricks within the schema.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes all currently classified fluid change products.

Childs.Title: Fluid Change Items Variety Packs (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products than can be described/observed as two or more distinct products, specifically designed to aid automotive fluid change, sold together, which exist within the schema belonging to different bricks but to the same class, that is two or more products contained within the same pack which cross bricks within the Fluid Change class. Items that are received free with purchases should be removed from the classification decision-making process.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes products classified within different classes sold together.

Childs.Title: Oil Mats (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a mat, specifically designed to absorb oil stains.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes car carpets.

Childs.Title: Drain Plugs (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a car device, specifically designed as a removable plug for holding oil.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes all drain plugs not specifically designed for cars.

Childs.Title: Filter Wrenches (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a metal ring with a handle specifically designed to fit an oil filter.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes any other wrenches specifically designed to be used with a car filter.

Childs.Title: Fluid Change Kits/Accessories
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a set of devices used as or in conjunction with a fluid change device. A kit may contain various fluid change devices and accessories.

Childs.Title: PLASTIC
Childs.Definition: Plastic is a material consisting of any of a wide range of synthetic or semi-synthetic organics that are malleable and can be molded into solid objects of diverse shapes. Plastics are typically organic polymers of high molecular mass, but they often contain other substances. They are usually synthetic, most commonly derived from petrochemicals, but many are partially natural. Plasticity is the general property of all materials that are able to irreversibly deform without breaking, but this occurs to such a degree with this class of moldable polymers that their name is an emphasis on this ability.

Childs.Definition: Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the type of engine degreaser or pollution control product.

Childs.Title: UNCLASSIFIED

Childs.Title: Automotive Fire Extinguishers
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that are kept in an automobile, used to extinguish a fire, often in an emergency situation. The container is filled with fire retardant chemicals or water that can put out a small fire. Includes products such as manually operated or automatic extinguishers.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes products such as environmental fire retardants and chemicals used to extinguish large fires, fire blankets, home/business fire extinguishers and fire water hoses.

Childs.Title: Back-up Alarms/Sensors
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a device consisting of a sensor mounted on the back of a vehicle which is engaged when the vehicle is put into reverse gear by giving a visual and audio warning.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes any other car alarms and sensors.

Childs.Title: Emergency Fuel Aids
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a set comprising a fuel can and/or hose and/or a device/funnel designed specifically to filter and remove condensation and contamination from any fuel stored in the fuel can.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes any non specific cans, hoses and DIY funnels.

Childs.Title: Emergency Road Side Kits
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a kit that contains essential tools necessary for a road emergency, such as spot light, emergency red light, tools, power supply, an assortment of auto fuses, a tyre pressure gauge or any others.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes tools and replacement parts sold separately.

Childs.Title: Mirrors (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that may be described/observed as a device specifically designed to be installed inside of the car for rear view or those that are attached to the back of a visor. The products include those with additional features, such as a clock. Also includes auto-dimming mirrors supplied with sensors to recognise and eliminate rear approaching light.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes interior mirrors not specifically designed for car safety.

Childs.Title: Parking Protections
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as device that can be placed on a wall or on a pillar, to protect the vehicle and may enhance the visibility of the obstacle to the driver. Specifically includes rectangular or any shape of white and red stripped box, designed to prevent scratching a vehicle in a garage during a parking manoeuvre.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes items that are mounted on the vehicle. Excludes road signs, item which are not designed to specifically protect the environment from the vehicle.

Childs.Title: Protective Hose Bridges (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes products that can be described/observed as a heavy duty ramped construction that provides protection for valuable cable and hose lines while ensuring a method of safe passage for vehicles.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes products such as protective cable/wiring channels classified in electrical supplies.

Childs.Title: Safety Other (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a car safety device or accessory, where the user of the schema is not able to classify the products in existing bricks within the schema.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes all currently classified Car Safety products.

Childs.Title: Safety Replacement Parts/Accessories (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a car safety replacement part or accessory.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes all currently classified Car Safety replacement parts or accessories.

Childs.Title: Safety Variety Packs (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products than can be described/observed as two or more distinct devices or accessories, specifically designed to enhance car safety, sold together, which exist within the schema belonging to different bricks but to the same class, that is two or more products contained within the same pack which cross bricks within the Car Safety class. Items that are received free with purchases should be removed from the classification decision-making process.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes products classified within different classes sold together.

Childs.Title: Warning Flags/Flag Staffs (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described as a heavy duty flag and flagstaff attached to a vehicle to warn motorists of a stationery vehicle or of a vehicle carrying an excessive load. The flags are normally made of a highly visible material and the flagstaffs may also hold a flashing light to warn motorists.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes products such as roadside automotive signs and triangles used to warn motorists.

Childs.Title: Warning Signs/Triangles (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a triangle sign that can be placed of the side of the road to show that there is a breakdown or crash ahead.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes any other car alarms and sensors.

Childs.Title: Glow Plug Variety Packs

Childs.Title: Glow Plugs

Childs.Title: Spark Plugs

Childs.Title: Spark Plugs Other

Childs.Title: Spark Plugs Variety Packs
Childs.Definition: Includes any products than can be described/observed as two or more distinct products, specifically designed to be used as or with a spark plug, sold together, which exist within the schema belonging to different bricks but to the same class, that is two or more products contained within the same pack which cross bricks within the Spark Plug class. Childs.Title: Adaptors - Hitch (Automotive)

Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes hitches or accessories.

Childs.Title: Draw Bars/Trailer Ball Mounts (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a device specifically designed to set up the trailer to tow on a level plane.

Childs.Title: Hitch Covers (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a cover, attached to the hitch receiver with a built in adapter to protect from water and to enhance its appearance.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes badges and signs.

Childs.Title: Hitch Hardware/Assemblies (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a kit, complete with the hitch receiver, draw bar, tow ball and other towing and hitch hardware or accessories.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes hitch hardware and accessories sold separately.

Childs.Title: Hitch Steps (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a panel or a tube, attached to the hitch receiver with a plastic step pad.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes hitch covers.

Childs.Title: Hitches (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a device used to connect a trailer to an automotive vehicle.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes hitch hardware and accessories.

Childs.Title: Pins/Clips - Hitch (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a device used to secure ball mount to receiver.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes hitches or other accessories.

Childs.Title: Receiver Tubes/Collars (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a device used to extend the hitch. The products may contain reinforced collars for additional strength.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes hitches, bars or other accessories.

Childs.Title: Safety Chains/Cables - Towing (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a chain or a cable, used to prevent the trailer from separating from the tow vehicle in event of hitch failure such as a hitch ball that has loosened.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes any other hitch accessories.

Childs.Title: Tow Bars (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a towing structure that is connected to a semi-trailer, trailer or converter and which includes an eye or equivalent device for the purpose of coupling with a trailer hitch. Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes any other hitch accessories.

Childs.Title: Tow Hooks (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a device, attached to the vehicle's frame that is used to provide an attachment point for wire hooks.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes badges and signs.

Childs.Title: Tow Ropes/Straps (Automotive)
Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as a line, chain or strap, attached to the vehicle's towing hook that is used for towing vehicles.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes safety chains.

Childs.Title: Towing Components - Heavy Duty

Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes all towing components not specifically designed for heavy duty towing.

Childs.Title: Towing Locking Accessories

Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes locking devices not specifically designed for towing equipment.

Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes any other automotive mirrors.

Childs.Title: Towing/Hitch Other

Childs.Title: Towing/Hitch Variety Packs

Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes products classified within different classes sold together.

Childs.Definition: Includes any products that can be described/observed as an electric device, specifically designed to provide smooth breaking and good feel by responding to the length that the tow vehicle brake pedal is depressed until the pre-set brake power setting is reached.
Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes all other electrical towing equipment.

Childs.Title: Connectors - Towing

Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes non-electrical connectors.

Childs.DefinitionExcludes: Excludes products classified within different classes sold together.
